rules.source_quote: Conference attendance must be pre-approved in writing by the employee's manager.
Conference registration fees are reimbursable at the standard attendee rate.
Premium passes are reimbursable only when they provide demonstrable business value not available at the standard rate.
Conference travel and lodging are reimbursed under TEP-004 (Lodging), TEP-005 (Air), and TEP-006 (Ground Transportation).
Conference total >$5,000 requires Director approval; >$10,000 or international requires VP approval.
Early-bird registration should be used when planned sufficiently in advance.
Meals included in conference registration are not separately reimbursable.
Off-site dinners with conference colleagues are not client entertainment unless external clients/prospects attend.
Conference attendance with clients follows TEP-002 §4 entertainment caps and VP approval conditions.
If personal extension increases airfare, comparison quote is required and difference is employee responsibility.
Attendees are expected to share conference takeaways within 30 days of return.
Non-refundable cancellation costs are absorbed only for legitimate reasons (manager decision, illness, business priority change).
